method: 26 stable section-label meanings factored against all already-read lesson title/credit bundles. 1382 bindings are repeated occurrences of these meanings, not 1382 different meanings. The helper text_fields deliberately omits nested arrangement section names, so these are separately exposed and bound. This is not sampling; each unique section label/role is read and adjudicated, and every title context was already read.
